panel.purpose: Heading of the Settings panel that leads to the Diagnostics screen.

open.purpose: Link from Settings to the Diagnostics screen.

back.purpose: Link back from the Diagnostics screen to Settings.

log.title.purpose: Heading of the panel that lists the recorded events.

log.help.purpose: Says what the event log holds and that it never holds names, paths or error text.
log.help.where: Diagnostics screen, event log panel, under the heading.

log.filter.purpose: Label of the choice that narrows the list to one kind of event.
log.filter.where: Diagnostics screen, event log panel, above the list.

log.all.purpose: The filter's choice that shows every event.
log.all.where: Diagnostics screen, event log panel, in the filter.

log.empty.purpose: Shown when the log has no events at all.
log.empty.where: Diagnostics screen, event log panel, instead of the list.

log.noMatch.purpose: Shown when the filter matches no event.
log.noMatch.where: Diagnostics screen, event log panel, instead of the list.

log.time.purpose: Column heading: when the event happened.
log.time.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, column heading.

log.what.purpose: Column heading: the kind of event.
log.what.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, column heading.

log.task.purpose: Column heading: the kind of background task the event is about.
log.task.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, column heading.

log.reason.purpose: Column heading: the reason code of a failure.
log.reason.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, column heading.

log.detail.purpose: Column heading: how long it took, or how many.
log.detail.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, column heading.

log.took.purpose: How long an event took, in milliseconds.
log.took.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, details column.

log.count_one.purpose: A count an event carries (jobs recovered at startup, stages that couldn't be asked).
log.count_one.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, details column.

log.count_other.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, details column.

log.lost_one.purpose: Warns that the log file couldn't be written for some events.
log.lost_one.where: Diagnostics screen, event log panel, above the list, only when a write failed.

log.lost_other.purpose: Warns that the log file couldn't be written for some events.
log.lost_other.where: Diagnostics screen, event log panel, above the list, only when a write failed.

log.error.purpose: The event log couldn't be loaded.

kind.jobStarted.purpose: Name of an event: a background task began.
kind.jobStarted.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

kind.jobFinished.purpose: Name of an event: a background task finished.
kind.jobFinished.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

kind.jobFailed.purpose: Name of an event: a background task failed.
kind.jobFailed.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

kind.jobCancelled.purpose: Name of an event: a background task was cancelled.
kind.jobCancelled.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

kind.rekordboxReadOk.purpose: Name of an event: rekordbox's export was read.
kind.rekordboxReadOk.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

kind.rekordboxReadFailed.purpose: Name of an event: reading rekordbox's export failed.
kind.rekordboxReadFailed.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

kind.databaseReadOk.purpose: Name of an event: rekordbox's database was read.
kind.databaseReadOk.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

kind.databaseReadFailed.purpose: Name of an event: reading rekordbox's database failed.
kind.databaseReadFailed.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

kind.sendPrepared.purpose: Name of an event: a send to rekordbox was prepared.
kind.sendPrepared.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

kind.sendDone.purpose: Name of an event: a send to rekordbox was written.
kind.sendDone.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

kind.sendRefused.purpose: Name of an event: a send to rekordbox was stopped.
kind.sendRefused.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

kind.startup.purpose: Name of an event: the app started, with how long it took.
kind.startup.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

kind.startupAsked.purpose: Name of an event: at startup the app asked what work is due.
kind.startupAsked.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

kind.libraryNotReplaced.purpose: Name of an event: an import or restore the user confirmed couldn't be finished at startup, so the Library already there opened instead. (PROPOSED, 4B-B1a)
kind.libraryNotReplaced.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list and filter.

reason.jobFailed.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.jobFailed.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.panicked.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.panicked.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.noHandler.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.noHandler.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.unknownKind.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.unknownKind.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.notFound.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.notFound.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.cantRead.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.cantRead.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.damaged.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.damaged.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.notAnExport.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.notAnExport.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.turnedOff.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.turnedOff.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.noKey.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.noKey.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.wrongKey.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.wrongKey.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.notALibrary.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.notALibrary.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.stopped.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.stopped.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.readFailed.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.readFailed.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.cancelled.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.cancelled.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.noPreflight.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.noPreflight.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.exportChanged.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.exportChanged.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.libraryChanged.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.libraryChanged.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.notSendable.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.notSendable.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.notConfirmed.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.notConfirmed.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.exportOlderThanLastSend.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.exportOlderThanLastSend.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.cantWrite.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.cantWrite.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.cantRecord.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.cantRecord.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.internal.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words.
reason.internal.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

reason.fileInTheWay.purpose: The reason code of a failed event, in words: a file already sat where the old Library is moved aside during an import. (PROPOSED, 4B-B1a)
reason.fileInTheWay.where: Diagnostics screen, event log list, reason column.

report.title.purpose: Heading of the panel that makes the diagnostics report.

report.help.purpose: Says what the report holds and that nothing is sent.
report.help.where: Diagnostics screen, report panel, under the heading.

report.create.purpose: Button that builds the report and shows it, before anything is saved.

report.creating.purpose: Shown while the report is built.
report.creating.where: Diagnostics screen, report panel, in place of the button's result.

report.previewLabel.purpose: Label of the box that shows the whole report text.
report.previewLabel.where: Diagnostics screen, report panel, over the text.

report.save.purpose: Button that saves the report text shown above as a file in the app's data folder.
report.save.where: Diagnostics screen, report panel, under the text.

report.saving.purpose: Shown on the save button while it saves.

report.saved.purpose: Confirms the report was saved and that old ones are removed.
report.saved.where: Diagnostics screen, report panel, after saving.

report.pathLabel.purpose: Label of the field that shows where the report file is.
report.pathLabel.where: Diagnostics screen, report panel, after saving.

report.copy.purpose: Button that copies the report text to the clipboard.
report.copy.where: Diagnostics screen, report panel, after saving.

report.copyPath.purpose: Button that copies the saved file's path to the clipboard.
report.copyPath.where: Diagnostics screen, report panel, after saving.

report.copied.purpose: Confirms something was copied to the clipboard.
report.copied.where: Diagnostics screen, report panel, after copying.

report.copyFailed.where: Diagnostics screen, report panel, after copying.
